name: basics: say what is in the history in front of the user
description: Tier 3, live Galaxy. The other half of arriving: not what the server can do, but what the user already has. The history is bound by the record, so naming its contents needs no question back to the user -- asking which history to look at is itself the failure this guards.
inputs: What datasets are in my history right now?
What format is it, and how many rows and columns does it have?
